name: Zahnašovice (Czechia)
description: Three vertical stripes of green, yellow and green in the ratio 1:1:1, with a white fleur-de-lis in the hoist green.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 12 May 1997 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
